tasks.description: Verify core application functionality including homepage, car listing API, car details page, admin authentication (registration, login), and email validation.
acceptance_criteria: Branding text 'Drive Your Dream' is visible on the homepage
Navigation and main content elements are present on the page
GET /api/cars returns HTTP 200 with proper car data structure
Each car in API response has _id, brand, name, and price_per_day fields
Car details page loads for valid car ID
Car details page displays car brand, name, and price
Admin registration page loads and creates new admin account
Invalid login credentials show 'Invalid email or password' error
Email format validation works on login form
